dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.intro: Listen to a word and write it down. Ten questions per round: type the pinyin, then pick the character you hear.
dictation.toneModeHint: How to write the tone: numbers (ni3 hao3), marks (nǐ hǎo) or none.
dictation.emptySource: No words available for this source yet. Add some cards to your review deck first.
dictation.error: Could not load the words. Check your connection and try again.
dictation.ttsUnavailable: This browser has no speech available, so the word is shown instead of played.
